youtube_metadata.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon: 1M Token Output Limit Unlocked #Shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
Google DeepMind has officially launched Gemini 4 Argon with an unprecedented 1-million-token output limit. Designed for defensive cyber operations in the Fairwind Program, it refactors codebases and patches zero-days in a single prompt.
